title: G0W0 Si k888 with Brillouin-zone symmetry, SG15 3s3p2d, five-stage pipeline
note: Symmetry-on Si G0W0, same physics as si-k888-sg15-g0w0 but with Brillouin-zone symmetry enabled end to end. INPUT_scf uses ABACUS symmetry = 1 (IBZ), INPUT_nscf stays at -1 for the band path, and librpa.in runs use_symmetry_exx/gw = t. Symmetry is the largest single cost switch in the pipeline: with it off the chi0/Wc family loops over the full 8x8x8 grid (512 q), with it on over the IBZ (roughly 20-30 q). The symmetry head/wing lane requires the full-BZ PyATB products (pyatb_librpa_df/velocity_matrix + KS_eigenvector_*), so that directory must stay in input_dir - the opposite of the symmetry-off lane, where its presence silently overrides LibRPA's own head term. nbands 44 equals nAO 44, which is the condition for the symmetry real-space contraction to work. Acceptance is judged on the rendered KS/EXX/GW band figure plus the reference-free gates (bands.qp_correction catches a star-overcounted Sigma_c, which is the known failure mode of this lane); the gap delta against the database 1.0596 eV is advisory. Definition: nfreq 16, minimax, n_params_anacon -1, cut-Coulomb EXX (use_fullcoul_exx f), LU Wc solve (use_cholesky_gw_wc f), matching the archived record.
